title: rosa afzeliana subf. aciphylloides
intro: Rosa afzeliana subf. aciphylloides, commonly known as Aciphylloides, is a subgenus of the Rosa afzeliana plant species. This plant is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Aciphylloides include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular diseases and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Aciphylloides include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
